rows.grounds: compound describing one who removes all diseases
compound indicating the arising of rebirth

items.question: What freedom from disease and rebirth characterizes the realized being?
premises: The realized being removes all diseases.
The realized being is not subject to rebirth.
These qualities define the realized state.
items.inference: Therefore, the realized being is free from both disease and the cycle of rebirth.
items.plain_english: He removes all diseases and indeed has no possibility of rebirth.

items.question: In what manner is the realized being pure and sovereign?
premises: The realized being is pure everywhere and always.
The realized being is sovereign everywhere and always.
Purity and sovereignty are unrestricted in space and time.
items.inference: Therefore, the realized being possesses unlimited purity and lordship.
items.plain_english: He is pure everywhere and always, and lord everywhere and always.
